items.author: Meha Agarwal
items.content:
In April 2016, a bike taxi startup barely a few months old persuaded some established names in Indian business to back the idea of sharing a motorcycle ride. Hero MotoCorp’s Pawan Munjal, Google’s Rajan Anandan and People Group founder Anupam Mittal were among the investors in Rapido’s pre-Series A round.
Its founders, Aravind Sanka, Pavan Guntupalli and Rishikesh SR, had early evidence that the idea could find takers. The funding would help them take the service to more cities and build the team.
The trio’s earlier logistics venture, Karrier, had shut down. This time, the proposition was simple. A motorcycle had a spare seat, its owner could use some extra income, and someone nearby needed an affordable ride. Rapido’s app would bring them together, handling bookings, fare estimates, matching and tracking. The founders could build a transport business without buying the vehicles themselves.
More than a decade after its founding, that spare seat has become the starting point for a much larger business, putting the mobility unicorn on the super app track. Rapido says it now facilitates over 5 Mn rides a day, operates across more than 400 cities and supports over 9 Mn livelihoods. In April 2025, Sanka had separately put its network at 2 Mn transacting bike taxi partners every month.
It has evolved from a bike-taxi platform into a broader, technology-enabled mobility and delivery ecosystem. Its services now span bikes, autos and cabs, parcel and hyperlocal delivery, food delivery through Ownly, and travel bookings.
That expansion has brought Rapido into closer competition with Ola and Uber, alongside regional alternatives such as Namma Yatri in Bengaluru, Yatri Sathi in Kolkata and Red Taxi across Tamil Nadu. However, Rapido’s own estimates suggest it has carved out a sizable share of this crowded market.
In an April 2025 interview, Sanka told Inc42 that it held 70% of India’s bike taxi market, nearly 40% of auto rides and 22% of cab hailing. These were the company’s estimates at the time. In the same interview, he outlined an IPO ambition over the following two to three years. Earlier this year, Rapido has also raised $240 Mn at a $3 Bn valuation.
Before Ownly entered the picture, Rapido was already growing its revenue and reducing losses. In FY25, operating revenue rose 44.2% to ₹934.4 Cr, while net loss fell 30.3% to ₹258.4 Cr. That was the second consecutive year of narrowing losses.
Rapido reported a net loss of ₹370 Cr in FY24, down 45.2% from ₹675 Cr in FY23, on operating revenue of ₹648.1 Cr. Revenue has therefore grown at a comparable rate two years running, 46.3% and then 44.2%. That makes the narrowing a trend rather than a single year’s result.
Although FY26 numbers are yet to be reported, Rapido’s GMV grew 111% year-on-year in H1 FY26, according to Prosus’ investor presentation. The business was gaining scale, but had yet to turn an annual profit.
Ownly’s Bengaluru pilot began in 2025 and added another business to that pursuit. This brings Rapido into competition with Swiggy and Zomato. Like ride-hailing, the company leaned towards zero restaurant commission model for food delivery too, with customers paying separately for delivery.
Rapido’s argument is that it already has some of the infrastructure needed to fulfil those orders. “By integrating Ownly into the Rapido ecosystem, the company can leverage its existing technology, consumer base, and delivery network rather than building an entirely separate infrastructure,” a spokesperson said.
Rapido now plans to deepen businesses where demand is already strong while selectively building adjacent services that can benefit from its existing ecosystem, according to its spokesperson. The question is whether using the same network across more services will bring in enough additional income to cover the cost of those additions.
In the past, we have looked at whether merely adding new services is enough for Rapido, as this results in a fragmented product proposition, which could open up risks of lower retention among active users.
Ownly has added magicpin as a partner, and the CCI has dismissed a predatory pricing complaint against Rapido. In August 2026, a report of talks with Uber to combine India operations, which Rapido denied, put the same question over the whole portfolio.
For a company still pursuing profitability, that is the test behind its widening portfolio. Who pays Rapido across these businesses, what do they pay for, and how much of that money stays with the company?
Rapido’s Mobility Subscription Bet
Rapido began with a commission model, taking a share of the fare on each ride booked through its platform. The model is well understood and has been in play since Uber first arrived on the scene.
But for drivers (Captains as Rapido calls them), that meant giving up part of the fare on every trip, even as they continued to pay for fuel and vehicle maintenance.
When it launched its cabs service in 2023 and then autos in 2024, the company started with a zero-commission proposition, giving driver greater control over their earnings.
Drivers pay a daily fee to be able to accept unlimited rides. The commercial logic was straightforward: drivers who kept more of the total fare earned would have a stronger reason to join and continue using Rapido.
Why does this work? Well, understand it like this. Under a fixed subscription, a driver pays for platform access rather than surrendering a percentage of every fare.
For example, a ₹30 daily fee works out to ₹3 per ride over ten rides, but ₹1.50 over twenty. These are hypothetical figures, but they explain the attraction: drivers
For Rapido, the trade-off is that a busier driver does not automatically pay more under the same fixed plan. Those additional rides can instead make the subscription worth renewing. However, in the near future, growing this income depends on how many drivers pay, what their plans cost and how consistently they renew. A large registered network alone cannot establish any of those things, and subscription collections must still cover technology, support, marketing and other operating expenses.
This explains why the next step in mobility is closely tied to making existing markets and networks work better.
Rapido is also no longer alone in offering it. Uber launched a SaaS-based zero-commission model in February 2025, and Ola followed with a subscription of its own.
Industry stakeholders and analysts believe the shift at Ola and Uber is less about empowering drivers and more about staying relevant. That leaves the subscription as a price the category now shares, rather than a lever that only Rapido has.
Deliveries Put The Network To Another Use
As a Rapido spokesperson said: “Parcel and hyperlocal delivery are natural extensions of Rapido’s existing network, creating additional use cases for the same supply infrastructure while providing more earning opportunities for Captains.”
When the pandemic disrupted passenger travel, Rapido found another use for its drivers: moving goods. By June 2020, it had expanded Rapido Local to Bengaluru, Kolkata and Hyderabad for food, grocery and medicine deliveries, and worked with retailers including BigBasket and Spencer’s.
It also launched Rapido Stores for businesses needing deliveries, onboarding more than 200 small and medium enterprises at the time. An order no longer had to originate on Rapido for its network to earn from moving it.
That business now extends to companies Rapido also competes with. In a March 2026 interview, Sanka said its network handled deliveries for Swiggy, Zomato, ecommerce and quick-commerce platforms, and identified ONDC as a major client. The distinction matters: Ownly competes for the customer’s food order, while Rapido’s logistics business can fulfil an order placed elsewhere.
There are two ways to look at the money. For business deliveries, the merchant or platform buys a logistics service, with Rapido’s earnings governed by the commercial agreement. A customer booking a parcel pickup is a different arrangement.
Rapido’s customer terms, under Section III, clause 13, describe drivers as providing package services through its platform. The amount paid to move a parcel is therefore not automatically the amount Rapido earns. The company has not disclosed the contract rates or margins needed to put a number on either arrangement.
The potential saving lies in giving an existing driver more work across the day. That could reduce idle time and spread the cost of maintaining the network across more jobs, although it depends on orders arriving where drivers are available.
A delivery still has to be worth doing. Two jobs paying the same amount can produce very different earnings if one involves a long pickup, a wait at the restaurant or a return journey without another booking.
For drivers, the test is earnings after expenses for the time spent; for Rapido, it is what remains after paying for fulfillment and support. Its responses do not disclose delivery margins or measured gains in driver earnings from switching between services. The opportunity is clear, but the financial benefit remains unquantified.
Ownly Changes Who Pays
With Ownly, Rapido is adding another vertical to its super app play by offering restaurant selection, handling ordering problems and giving people a reason to switch from apps they already use. But here’s an interesting twist.
During the Bengaluru pilot in August 2025, Inc42 reported a ₹25 restaurant charge per order, plus GST, while customer delivery fees were waived in the areas served. By July 2026, Ownly was offering zero restaurant commission, with customers paying separately for food and delivery. The restaurant receives the food payment; the delivery charge provides Rapido’s route to income.
That changes who pays for the service, but the delivery still costs money. A restaurant saving on commission may have room to lower its menu prices. For the customer, however, the comparison is the final bill, including delivery. A cheaper meal is less persuasive if the delivery fee wipes out the savings.
Rapido is trying to make that bill work by bringing food ordering to people who already use its mobility services. In July 2026, it integrated Ownly into the main Rapido app and signed an agreement with the National Restaurant Association of India to strengthen restaurant engagement. These give it routes to reach both sides of the marketplace, although neither guarantees repeat orders.
As a Rapido spokesperson said, “Rapido sees food delivery as an important adjacent opportunity. The zero-commission model is designed to address some of the structural challenges faced by restaurants, while Rapido’s existing technology and delivery network provide an operational advantage. The focus is on building density, adoption, and sustainable unit economics as the model expands.”
In a March 2026 interview, Sanka said bike drivers could choose to accept food deliveries alongside passenger rides and parcel bookings. But using the same driver does not eliminate payment for the delivery. Rapido has not disclosed the detailed arrangement for collecting delivery charges and settling driver payments, so it would be premature to assume how much it retains.
A hypothetical example explains the economics without assuming that payment arrangement. Suppose a customer pays ₹30 for delivery and ₹25 goes to the driver. Only ₹5 remains to cover payment processing, customer support and other expenses; it is not yet profit. If the driver needs ₹35 for that job, the ₹30 charge falls short by ₹5 before those expenses.
The challenge is sharper for inexpensive meals. A ₹100 lunch can take as much time to deliver as a ₹400 order, but a large delivery charge makes the cheaper meal harder to sell. Having restaurants, customers and available drivers close together can reduce travel and waiting time, helping make each order less expensive to fulfil.
Whether that advantage translates into profit will become clearer as Ownly scales, provided Rapido discloses enough detail to separate its performance from the wider business. FY27 financials could offer a fuller picture, but company-wide revenue growth alone would not establish whether food delivery is profitable.
The competitive consequences are already visible. Swiggy, which led Rapido’s $180 Mn round in 2022, approved a stake sale to Prosus and WestBridge for about ₹2,400 Cr in September 2025, following Rapido’s entry into food ordering. Rapido was now competing for orders it had previously helped fulfil. Winning those orders is the next challenge; earning enough from delivering them will determine whether Ownly strengthens the business.
Why The Super App Push Matters
Rapido’s travel push gives its super app ambition a concrete shape. In October 2025, it added a dedicated travel section through partnerships with Goibibo, redBus and ConfirmTkt, covering flights, hotels, buses and trains.
At the time of the announcement, Rapido claimed 5 Cr active users and set an ambition to bring another 10 Cr users into digital travel. The partners supply the booking services; Rapido brings distribution. It resembles PhonePe’s arrangement with ixigo, where a high frequency app becomes a sales channel for other businesses.
As a Rapido spokesperson said: “Adjacent services including offerings such as flight bookings are part of the broader ambition to make Rapido a more comprehensive platform for everyday mobility and related needs.”
The company confirms that flight bookings generate revenue, but has not disclosed its fee or share of each booking. The opportunity is to earn at more points in a journey: from the travel reservation through a partner to the ride fulfilled by a driver. Whether customers actually book both remains to be demonstrated.
Advertising already offers more specific examples of how Rapido sells access to its audience. Its 2025 advertising deck describes a Lufthansa campaign targeting frequent and business travellers, and a Sprite campaign placed around summer commutes.
Advertisers can appear while customers search for a driver, wait for pickup or begin a ride, with targeting options including location, time and travel intent. Rapido also offers placements on its driver app, making drivers an audience for advertisers as well as providers of transport.
These businesses add two distinct sources of income: travel bookings generate earnings under partner agreements, while brands pay for advertising placements. The latter can earn from a customer’s visit even when they buy no additional service.
Rapido has not disclosed either channel’s revenue contribution, but the commercial direction is clearer: its super app push is creating more things to sell around the ride, including tickets, hotel bookings and advertising space.
The Risk Of Regulation
Regulation and safety remain two of Rapido’s biggest challenges. Maharashtra’s licensing disputes and Karnataka’s bike-taxi restrictions show how quickly a service can lose access to a market. Karnataka’s cab-aggregator licence gives its four-wheeler business permission to operate until August 2031, while the bike-taxi dispute has followed a separate legal path. For a company expanding across services, permission in one category does not settle the others.
An interruption also weakens the economics of subscriptions. drivers need bookings to justify paying for access; passengers need available rides to keep opening the app. If either leaves, restarting operations can mean spending again to rebuild demand and driver availability. Tax decisions add another pressure: Karnataka’s 2024 advance ruling on Rapido’s cab services shows that a SaaS arrangement can still carry tax obligations that affect pricing and earnings.
Keeping customers’ trust requires investment, too. Inc42’s September 2025 report documented complaints about fares, driver verification and support. Rapido’s safety guidelines describe training, trip sharing, insurance and assistance, but their value depends on how consistently they work.
These responsibilities will follow Rapido into every new market. Its next phase therefore comes down to where it can build a dependable service, attract repeat business and earn enough to sustain both.
What Comes Next For Rapido?
Rapido’s expanding portfolio raises a question about priorities: how much attention and money will go into its established business, and how much into newer services? The company puts mobility first.
The next phase will focus on depth, efficiency, and selective expansion – strengthening the core mobility network, improving technology and driver utilisation, and scaling adjacent businesses where Rapido’s existing ecosystem provides a clear advantage. The aim is to build a sustainable, multi-modal platform with mobility at its core.
Asked whether it would go deeper into existing businesses or expand horizontally, the spokesperson added: “Rapido sees these as complementary rather than mutually exclusive. The company intends to go deeper in its core mobility businesses while selectively expanding into adjacent categories where its technology, customer base, and driver network provide a structural advantage.”
The practical decision is where another investment can make the biggest difference, whether by improving an unreliable pickup, bringing more drivers online or adding a service customers need. The objective is not to add categories for the sake of expansion, but to identify areas where Rapido can solve a genuine customer or partner problem using infrastructure it has already built.
Smaller cities remain central to that calculation. For Rapido, the biggest opportunity remains the continued formalisation and digitisation of everyday mobility across India, particularly beyond the metros. Rapido has built a presence across 400+ cities, with deep reach into Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets. The focus is on strengthening this network and making mobility more accessible, affordable, and reliable rather than treating growth simply as a city-count exercise.
That makes the quality of its presence as important as its geographical reach. A city already on the map can still offer room to grow through more reliable availability and more frequent bookings. Alongside that work, Rapido sees newer services becoming part of a connected business.
“At the same time, businesses such as Ownly demonstrate how the underlying technology and network can be extended into adjacent categories. The long-term ambition is to build the ‘Wheels of Bharat’, a technology-led ecosystem where mobility, logistics, and related services reinforce one another,” a Rapido spokesperson said.
For a company with IPO ambitions, the next convincing evidence will be financial – which businesses can support themselves, and which still need money from elsewhere. Rapido began by finding an earning opportunity in a spare motorcycle seat. It has since found several more around the same customer and driver. The challenge now is deciding which deserves the next rupee of investment, and which can start paying for the company’s future.

RuPay Credit Card
items.author: Anne Florentyna
items.content:
Adding to the spree of UPI launches at the Global Fintech Festival (GFF) 2026 in Mumbai, Reserve Bank of India (RBI) executive director Gunveer Singh introduced a comprehensive suite of payment initiatives spanning digital ticketing, mobility payments and ecommerce.
Key Innovations Unveiled at GFF 2026 Today
Unified Ticketing Platform (UTP)
Developed under NBBL and hosted by NTSL, the Unified Ticketing Platform integrates urban transit systems and cultural heritage sites into a standardised digital framework on Bharat Connect. The broader idea is to disparate ticketing applications, streamline merchant reconciliation and simplify route discovery for commuters and tourists.
It utilises dynamic and static offline-capable QR codes to deliver instant ticketing without network lag.
UTP is currently piloted with Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL) for urban mass transit and the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) under the Ministry of Culture for landmark and monument entry.
RuPay Credit Card on UPI International
This extends India’s linked-credit UPI ecosystem to international merchant acceptance points. Travelers and overseas shoppers can scan foreign QR codes or pay international ecommerce merchants directly using their preferred UPI app linked to a RuPay credit card.
The initial global corridors where this service would be rolled out would be the France, Mauritius, the UAE, and the US.
It also displays real-time foreign currency amounts, live exchange rates, bank forex markup fees, and the final INR equivalent before the user enters their UPI PIN.
RuPay ON-THE-GO Card-on-Device Tokenisation
This is a transit payment architecture built for NFC-enabled Android smartphones to cut operational overhead for transit agencies by replacing physical plastic smartcards with instant digital onboarding.
It allows commuters to issue, tokenise, and store transit credentials directly on their mobile device’s secure element and is designed for ultra-low latency environments. It allows passengers to tap-and-go at transit turnstiles even in low-connectivity underground stations.
RuPay ‘Tap on Phone’ For Ecommerce
The new feature brings physical contact-free card mechanics to online checkout flows. It would allow customers to tap their physical RuPay card against an NFC-enabled smartphone during mobile or web checkouts.
This feature supports payments up to ₹5,000 using standard card PIN authentication, removing dependency on SMS one-time passwords (OTPs) as well as eliminating manual card entry errors, drastically cuts checkout friction, and increases transaction success rates.
RuPay Passkey-Based Biometric Authentication
This new authentication replaces vulnerable legacy OTPs with FIDO-aligned device-native biometric authentication. Now, cardholders could authenticate online purchases, recurring mandates, and high-value transfers using device-native fingerprints or facial recognition (face ID).
It operates across iOS, Android, web browsers, as well as tokenised RuPay merchant gateways.
This adds on the spree of UPI related innovations launched during the GFF 2026, with the NPCI introducing a series of digital infrastructure initiatives to expand credit access across India during the GFF 2026. The UPI operator rolled out AiNxt, an open-source, enterprise-grade agentic AI platform designed to build, test, and deploy custom intelligent agents.
The suite incorporates four core components: AiNxt OS, AiNxt Code (a plugin for integrated development environments or IDEs), AiNxt CLI, and AiNxt Enterprise. These will enable development teams to build, test, and deploy across IDEs and command-line environments.
The Department of Financial Services’ secretary Sanjay Lohiya also unveiled open-source android ATMs to instantly issue RuPay cards and merchant UPI QR code.
At the GFF 2026 inauguration, PM Narendra Modi highlighted that the next phase of UPI’s growth should focus on connecting the Indian payment system with payment ecosystems of other countries.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Airlink has launched a new Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) facility in partnership with ABHI Microfinance Bank, making it easier for customers to purchase smartphones, laptops and other electronic products through monthly installments.
The new service has been rolled out across 13 Airlink retail outlets in Karachi. It allows eligible customers to buy products immediately and pay for them over a period of several months.
Airlink Launches Buy Now, Pay Later Facility With ABHI Microfinance Bank
Under the new facility, customers can choose from 3, 6, 9 and 12-month installment plans. The process is fully digital and includes quick loan approval, according to the announcement.
The partnership aims to make premium technology products more accessible to consumers who may prefer paying in installments rather than making the full payment upfront.
Customers can apply for the financing directly through the BNPL process and complete the required steps digitally.
Apple, Samsung and Xiaomi Products Covered
The facility covers a wide range of products available through Airlink’s retail network. This includes the complete Apple lineup, with products such as iPhones, MacBooks, iPads, Apple Watch and AirPods.
Airlink also offers Samsung products through the facility, including the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra. Customers can also use the service to purchase Xiaomi smartphones, LED TVs and other eligible electronics.
Airlink operates as an authorized reseller for Apple products, adding a wider selection of premium devices to the installment offering.
Initial Rollout in Karachi
The Airlink and ABHI BNPL service is currently available at 13 Airlink retail outlets in Karachi. The company said the rollout followed extensive planning, technology integration and on-ground implementation.
Airlink described the launch as an important step toward making premium technology more affordable and accessible to a larger number of customers.
The company also indicated that the current Karachi rollout is only the beginning. It plans to expand the facility to more stores and cities in the future.
More Consumer Financing Options Expected
The partnership between Airlink and ABHI Microfinance Bank combines Airlink’s retail network with ABHI’s digital financing platform. The companies expect the service to give consumers another option for purchasing high-value technology products.
With installment plans extending up to 12 months, the BNPL facility could make products such as flagship smartphones, laptops, and other electronics easier to purchase without paying the entire cost upfront.

items.author: Shrishti Bisht
items.content:
Actor Triptii Dimri has joined D2C eye-focused beauty brand Peep Beauty as an investor and co-creator as the startup looks to build a beauty category around coloured contact lenses and eye makeup.
As part of the association, Dimri has been involved in the startup’s creative direction, product discussions, and brand storytelling from its early stages, the startup said in a statement.
Dimri’s investment is part of the startup’s pre-seed funding round of ₹12 Cr ($1.2 Mn) led by Sadev Ventures, with participation from iSeed, ISV and TDV.
The round also saw participation from a clutch of angel investors, including Arjun Vaidya (V3 Ventures cofounder), Puneet Gupta (Astrotalk founder), Roman Saini (Unacademy cofounder), Gaurav Khatri (Noise cofounder), Dhruv Bhasin (Arata cofounder), among others.
Founded earlier this year by ex-Keventers cofounder Aman Arora, Peep Beauty operates in the coloured contact lens and eye makeup segments. The startup claims to be India’s first dedicated eye beauty brand.
Betting On Coloured Lenses
Peep Beauty launched with coloured contact lenses as its flagship product and is positioning them as everyday beauty and fashion accessories. The startup said its products have been designed specifically for Indian eye tones.
The startup currently offers lenses in five shades currently, priced at ₹399 per pair.
It has also launched six liquid eyeshadows. While its matte range is priced at ₹799, metallic eyeshadows cost ₹849.
Arora told Inc42 earlier this year that the eyeshadow range was introduced to allow customers to build complete looks around the coloured lenses.
The startup plans to add products such as mascara and eyeliner to its portfolio, allowing customers to create different eye-focused looks instead of using its lenses as standalone products.
Peep Beauty also plans to expand its contact lens portfolio to around 15-20 shades over the next few years. Besides conventional colours such as brown and grey, it intends to introduce more experimental shades for occasions such as Halloween.
As a digital-first brand, Peep Beauty plans to sell through its D2C platform while expanding its presence on ecommerce marketplaces and quick commerce platforms. It also intends to collaborate with creators, makeup artists, dancers, and other artists to promote the brand.
The development comes as D2C brands increasingly bring celebrities on board as investors and strategic collaborators to boost visibility and strengthen their consumer connect.
Earlier this year, D2C jewellery brand GIVA onboarded actor Kriti Sanon as an investor. In June, D2C kids’ lifestyle brand Rosada brought actor Shilpa Shetty Kundra on board as a strategic investor as it looks to expand its footprint across India.
Sportswear startup Agilitas Sports also onboarded actor Anushka Sharma as an investor and strategic collaborator. Meanwhile, footwear brand Chupps roped in Indian cricketer Ajinkya Rahane as an investor and strategic advisor.

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Pakistan has moved ahead with two major technology projects worth a combined Rs 40.8 billion under the government’s Uraan Pakistan initiative, including the PakSat-2 Satellite System and a new Geo-AI Development & Innovation Hub.
The Central Development Working Party (CDWP), chaired by the Federal Minister for Planning, Development, and Special Initiatives Ahsan Iqbal reviewed the proposals as part of a broader push to strengthen the country’s space, artificial intelligence, and digital capabilities.
The PakSat-2 Satellite System, valued at Rs 37.19 billion, was recommended to the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC) for further consideration. The CDWP also approved the GEOSPATIALx COMPLEx (Geo-AI Development & Innovation Hub) at a cost of Rs 3.62 billion.
PakSat-2 and Geo-AI Hub at the Center of Technology Push
Ahsan Iqbal said development of Pakistan’s space program was an important pillar of Uraan Pakistan, with the PakSat-2 project expected to strengthen national satellite and space capabilities.
The Geo-AI hub, meanwhile, is aimed at expanding the use of geospatial technologies and artificial intelligence for research, planning, innovation, and digital applications.
Together, the two projects reflect the government’s effort to build capacity in advanced technologies while improving the country’s digital and research infrastructure.
The CDWP also considered the Federal Board of Revenue’s Transforming and Digitalizing Revenue Administration (TADRA) project, worth Rs 57.11 billion, and recommended it to ECNEC for further consideration.
The project is proposed to be financed through Asian Development Bank support and is intended to modernize tax administration, expand the taxpayer base, and support efforts to raise the tax-to-GDP ratio to 13.5% by 2029.
Focus Expands to AI, Cybersecurity and Advanced Research
The meeting also reviewed technology and higher-education initiatives linked to the development of national research capacity.
A delayed center originally approved in 2018 was revisited as part of a wider network of national technology centers. Seven centers covering Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Big Data and Cloud Computing, GIS and Satellite Technology, Automation and Robotics, Applied Mathematics, and Livestock and Genomics have already been completed.
Ahsan Iqbal directed that the remaining center be updated to reflect newer emerging fields and called for similar facilities to be established in universities across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Sindh, and Balochistan.
He also emphasized the need to upgrade laboratories at engineering universities and strengthen links between academic research, innovation, and commercialization.
The latest approvals place space technology, Geo-AI, digital governance, and advanced research among the key technology priorities being pursued under the Uraan Pakistan development framework.

items.author: Yus Lianson
items.content:
OpenAI baru saja memperbarui ChatGPT Images 2.5, di mana kemampuan model AI untuk membuat dan mengedit gambar diklaim semakin meningkat ketimbang generasi sebelumnya. Tak hanya itu, ChatGPT Images 2.5 menyoroti satu masalah yang kerap muncul ketika mengedit gambar dengan AI.
Adapun masalah tersebut adalah menjaga bagian sebenarnya tidak ingin diubah. Raksasa kecerdasan buatan ini mengklaim, kemampuan ChatGPT Images 2.5 dalam mempertahankan subjek dari foto referensi meningkat.
Mengutip keterangan resmi OpenAI, Jumat (11/9/2026), Images 2.5 mampu menghasilkan pencahayaan lebih natural dan tekstur detail. Perusahaan juga mengklaim, latensi pembuatan gambar diklaim turun hingga 50 persen dibaningkan Images 2.0.
Baca Juga: Jadwal MPL ID S18 Hari Ini 11 September: Evos Tantang Dewa United
Pembaruan Images 2.5 hadir ketika penggunaan fitur gambar OpenAI terus meluas. Menurut perusahaan, lebih dari 3 miliar gambar dibuat setiap minggu melalui ChatGPT Images dan model GPT-Image di API. Angka tersebut mencakup penggunaan di ChatGPT maupun layanan dibangun developer menggunakan API OpenAI.
Edit Gambar ChatGPT Images 2.5 Makin Presisi
Salah satu peningkatan utama Images 2.5 ada pada precision editing. OpenAI mengatakan, model baru ini lebih mampu mengubah elemen yang diminta pengguna tanpa ikut mengubah detail lain di sekitarnya.
Dalam praktiknya, pengguna bisa meminta perubahan pada satu objek, latar belakang, atau elemen teks sambil mempertahankan subjek dan komposisi gambar sudah sesuai. Kemampuan seperti ini juga ditujukan untuk workflow produksi yang membutuhkan konsistensi visual, termasuk materi produk dan aset dengan identitas merek tertentu.
ChatGPT Images 2.5. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
OpenAI turut meningkatkan konsistensi ketika pengguna melakukan beberapa revisi secara berurutan. Images 2.5 diklaim lebih mampu mempertahankan perubahan sebelumnya saat menerima instruksi berikutnya, tanpa kualitas gambar semakin menurun selama proses editing berlangsung.
Peningkatan tersebut cukup penting karena proses membuat gambar AI tidak selalu selesai dalam satu prompt. Hasil awal mungkin sudah memiliki komposisi yang sesuai, tetapi pengguna masih perlu memperbaiki teks, objek, warna, atau detail kecil lainnya. Semakin banyak bagian gambar yang berubah tanpa diminta, semakin banyak pula revisi yang harus dilakukan kembali.
ChatGPT 2.5 Bisa Gambar Sketsa dan Beri Komentar pada Gambar
Bersamaan dengan model baru, OpenAI menambahkan beberapa cara baru untuk mengontrol proses pembuatan gambar di ChatGPT.
Fitur Sketch memungkinkan pengguna menggambar referensi kasar langsung di ChatGPT. Sketsa tersebut kemudian dapat digunakan sebagai panduan visual untuk menghasilkan gambar akhir. 
OpenAI memberi contoh penggunaannya untuk menentukan layout ruangan, bentuk pakaian, sampai sekadar mengembangkan doodle menjadi gambar yang lebih lengkap. Sketch dapat diakses dengan mengetik @Sketch di ChatGPT.
Pengguna juga bisa memberikan komentar langsung pada gambar untuk menunjukkan bagian tertentu yang ingin direvisi. Pada aplikasi mobile, OpenAI menjelaskan pengguna dapat membuka gambar hasil generasi dalam tampilan penuh kemudian melakukan edit atau menambahkan komentar mengenai perubahan yang diinginkan.
Selain itu tersedia Templates untuk beberapa format visual populer. Pengguna dapat memulai dari template seperti poster atau merchandise, kemudian menambahkan informasi, elemen desain, dan gaya yang diinginkan. Dalam beberapa kasus, ChatGPT dapat memberikan pertanyaan lanjutan untuk memperjelas hasil yang ingin dibuat.
OpenAI juga menambahkan opsi untuk membagikan prompt bersama gambar. Orang lain kemudian dapat menggunakan ide prompt tersebut dengan gambar atau detail mereka sendiri.
Perlu dicatat, berdasarkan release notes saat peluncuran, Templates belum tersedia di ChatGPT Work, sementara batas penggunaan fitur pembuatan gambar yang sudah berlaku sebelumnya tidak berubah.
ChatGPT Images 2.5 Bisa Dipakai untuk Apa?
ChatGPT Images 2.5. (Gizmologi/ Yuslianson)
Bagi pengguna yang ingin langsung mencoba, Images 2.5 dapat dipakai untuk beberapa skenario sederhana. Misalnya membuat visual perayaan Hari Olahraga Nasional dari foto pribadi, mengubah foto menjadi gaya era 1980-an, menyusun e-flyer informatif berbasis data terbaru, hingga membuat materi edukatif visual dalam bahasa Indonesia.
Fitur Sketch bisa membantu saat pengguna ingin memberi panduan bentuk atau layout secara kasar, sementara komentar langsung pada gambar memudahkan revisi pada bagian tertentu tanpa harus mengulang dari awal. 
Untuk kebutuhan berbasis data seperti infografik abu vulkanik atau kondisi gunung berapi, hasil visual tetap perlu diverifikasi kembali agar informasi yang ditampilkan tetap akurat.

items.content: Shares of wire manufacturer KEI Industries declined as much as 4% to their day’s low of Rs 4,446 on the BSE on Friday after international brokerage firm Jefferies slashed the target price by 11% to Rs 6,150 from Rs 6,920, an upside of 31%. The brokerage, however, retains a Buy call on the stock.“Ultratech’s launch has raised investor concerns on KEI’s future profitability. We believe current market price factors in approx. 300 bps loss in market share for KEI over FY26-30E in its retail segment and no offset from power or exports,” the brokerage said in a note.Jefferies has factored in a 50 bps compression in KEI Industries’ margins over FY26-30E, while noting that the company’s retail segment remains the key area of risk from UltraTech Cement’s entry into wires and low-tension cables. Retail contributes 54% of KEI’s revenue and is primarily driven by housing.KEI has steadily increased its retail share through branding and dealer expansion since 2017-18, with its retail market share rising from 7% in FY17 to 21% in FY26. Over the same period, the industry’s unorganised share declined from 35-40% to around 25%.Jefferies expects KEI’s expansion into Europe and the US over the past 2-3 years to start yielding results. It also expects domestic power transmission capex to rise 2.6x in FY26E-30E versus FY21-25.The brokerage’s price target assumes KEI’s retail market share remains at 22% over FY27E-30E, while EBITDA margin rises by 50 bps to 11.5%. However, even if KEI loses some market share, Jefferies believes the company is well placed to offset the impact through domestic power transmission cable sales and exports.KEI Industries is trading at 36x P/E on September 2027E earnings, in line with its five-year average. Jefferies’ target price cut values the company at 40x P/E on September 2028E earnings, compared with 45x earlier, as it factors in some multiple compression following a more aggressive-than-expected launch by UltraTech.The revised valuation remains at a premium to the five-year average P/E of 36x, supported by improving visibility on exports and power transmission. Jefferies expects KEI’s EPS to grow at a 20% CAGR over FY26-29E. The key downside risk, according to the brokerage, is sharp pricing competition in cables.Also read: SBI's 80 paise masterstroke: How NSE IPO could deliver Rs 2,850 crore jackpot and 2,23,025% returnHowever, KEI Industries’ management said the company can defend its retail market share, supported by its established brand and loyal dealer network, while its prices remain competitive at 3-4% lower than other players. Management maintained its FY27E guidance of 25% revenue growth and 11-12% EBITDA margin, which implies 3-13% upside potential to the brokerage’s FY27E EPS estimates.Within Power T&D, Extra High Voltage (EHV) cables remain highly profitable, with only two domestic players, KEI and Universal Cables, currently present in the segment.(Disclaimer: Recommendations, suggestions, views and opinions given by the experts are their own. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

items.author: Anne Florentyna
items.content:
Electric two-wheeler (E2W) maker Ultraviolette Automotive is set to raise an additional ₹373.04 Cr as part of its ongoing Series E funding round from investors Yali Capital, TDK Ventures, among others.
As per an MCA filings accessed by Inc42, Ultraviolette’s shareholders consented to allot on preferential basis through private placement 8.15 Lakh Series E3 compulsorily convertible preference shares (CCPS) worth ₹2,435 each, aggregating to ₹197.5 Cr. The startup also allotted 7.24 Lakh Series E4 CCPS, netting ₹175.5 Cr.
“The investments are part of a currently ongoing fundraise; we have nothing further to add at the moment,” the startup said in response to Inc42’s questions pertaining to the round.
Of this, Ultraviolette has raised ₹249.2 Cr from Yali Capital’s Yali Deeptech Fund I as well as TDK Ventures. TDK Ventures first backed the startup in August 2025 when it led its $21 Mn funding round while Yali Capital will be new to Ultraviolette’s cap table.
There are a host of angel investors participating in this round including, Adi Hirji Jehangir, Anshumi Desai, Janak Desai, Mahak Khabia, Zafar Ahmadullah, among others.
The investment comes almost a year after the startup raised $45 Mn as part of the Series E round from Zoho and Lingotto. Overall, the startup has raised more than $135 Mn till date from other investors like TVS Motors, Qualcomm Ventures, Breathe Capital and Mudhal Partners.
The new investment comes as the E2W manufacturer is building its manufacturing facility, the BIGGA factory.
Ultraviolette To Invest ₹1,000 Cr In Manufacturing
The E2W maker is investing more than ₹1,000 Cr over the next five years to expand its manufacturing footprint, with its upcoming BIGGA Factory set to take its annual production capacity to as much as 2.5 Lakh vehicles in the initial phase.
The startup intends to invest approximately ₹800 Cr in the new facility, while another ₹200 Cr is being deployed to expand its existing Bengaluru plant. The new facility will initially have an annual capacity of 2.5 Lakh vehicles, which can eventually be scaled to 5 Lakh vehicles, cofounders Narayan Subramaniam and Niraj Rajmohan told Inc42.
The capacity expansion comes as Ultraviolette looks to move beyond its initial premium, performance-led positioning and target larger segments of the E2W market with new products such as the Shockwave and Tesseract.
However, the startup said the strategy itself has not changed.
“Ultraviolette was conceived from the outset as an electric-vehicle platform company,” the founders said, highlighting that the F77 was the first expression of this approach, followed by the X-47 crossover. The upcoming products, they said, will allow the company to address “significantly larger customer segments” while retaining its focus on technology, safety, performance and range.
The cofounders claim that demand across its existing portfolio already exceeds 10,000 units a month, while it has received tens of thousands of bookings for upcoming products. It plans to commission capacity progressively in line with demand.
Ultraviolette currently has an installed capacity of around 30,000 vehicles annually at its Bengaluru facility, which is being expanded to 50,000-60,000 units. The plant will continue to serve as a manufacturing, engineering and technology hub after the BIGGA Factory comes online.
It is also targeting international markets, with exports expected to account for around 25% of revenue over the next five years.
“BIGGA Factory converts that technology foundation into industrial scale,” the founders said, positioning the facility as a key step towards building a global electric-mobility business.
To note, the startup launched its F77 motorcycles in the United Kingdom, in November last year, and claimed to be present in 12 countries across Europe, as of its last fundraise.
For the month of August, overall E2W registrations fell by 16.2% to 1.72 Lakh units from 2.05 Lakh units in July, based on Vahan data. Ultraviolette sold 583 E2Ws, down 17% from 702 vehicles in July. It holds 0.3% market share in the domestic market.

items.author: Bambang Dwi Atmoko
items.content:
Kehadiran MacBook Neo menunjukkan semakin kuatnya tren laptop yang menggabungkan desain tipis, bobot ringan, dan performa untuk kebutuhan sehari-hari. Kini muncul pesaingnya dari segmen laptop Windows: Advan Air Neo. Laptop besutan Advan tersebut resmi meluncur dengan bobot di bawah 1 kg dan desain tipis untuk pengguna yang mengutamakan mobilitas.
Laptop terbaru ADVAN ini memiliki bobot 0,99 kg, ketebalan 12,9 mm, serta menggunakan prosesor Intel Core Series 3 berbasis Wildcat Lake. Menariknya, Advan Air Neo diposisikan sebagai alternatif di tengah tren laptop tipis dan ringan yang ikut mendapat perhatian setelah kehadiran MacBook Neo. Dengan harga mulai Rp9,99 juta, laptop ini tersedia dalam dua pilihan prosesor, yakni Intel Core 3 Processor 304 dan Intel Core 5 Processor 320.
Bobot Kurang dari 1 Kg Jadi Daya Tarik Utama
Jika ada satu angka yang paling mudah menjelaskan positioning AIR NEO, angka tersebut adalah 0,99 kg. Dengan bobot kurang dari 1 kg dan ketebalan 12,9 mm, laptop ini dirancang untuk pengguna yang sering berpindah tempat, baik dari kantor ke meeting, kampus ke kafe, maupun bekerja dari rumah.
ADVAN juga menggunakan material metal pada bodinya. Kombinasi tersebut membuat AIR NEO tidak sekadar mengejar dimensi ringkas, tetapi juga mencoba memberikan tampilan yang lebih premium.
Untuk kebutuhan kerja dan hiburan, laptop ini memiliki layar 14 inci FHD+ IPS. Ukuran tersebut memberikan area kerja yang cukup luas sekaligus tetap mempertahankan fokus AIR NEO sebagai perangkat yang mudah dibawa.
Konsep ini sejalan dengan tagline yang digunakan ADVAN, “Lightness Meets Intelligence”. Menurut Brand Director ADVAN Indonesia Andy Gusena, kata “lightness” tidak hanya merujuk pada bobot perangkat, tetapi juga bagaimana laptop tersebut dapat mengikuti mobilitas pengguna.
“Bagi kami, ‘Lightness Meets Intelligence’ bukan hanya berbicara mengenai laptop yang ringan secara fisik. Kami ingin produktivitas pengguna juga terasa lebih ringan,” ujar Andy.
Menggunakan Intel Core Series 3 Berbasis Wildcat Lake
Di balik bodinya yang tipis, AIR NEO menggunakan Intel Core Series 3, platform Intel yang sebelumnya dikenal dengan codename Wildcat Lake. ADVAN menyediakan dua konfigurasi. Varian pertama menggunakan Intel Core 3 Processor 304, sedangkan model yang lebih tinggi mengandalkan Intel Core 5 Processor 320.
Keduanya diposisikan untuk memberikan keseimbangan antara performa dan efisiensi pada kebutuhan komputasi sehari-hari. Intel juga menempatkan platform ini sebagai bagian dari perkembangan PC yang semakin siap menangani workload berbasis AI.
Country Manager Intel Indonesia Harry K. Nugraha mengatakan Core Series 3 ditujukan untuk menghadirkan keseimbangan antara performa, efisiensi, serta kesiapan terhadap perkembangan AI.
“Kami melihat kolaborasi dengan ADVAN melalui AIR NEO sebagai langkah positif untuk membawa pengalaman komputasi generasi baru tersebut kepada lebih banyak konsumen di Indonesia,” ujar Harry.
Namun, materi peluncuran belum mencantumkan detail teknis kemampuan AI AIR NEO, seperti performa NPU atau angka TOPS. Karena itu, label AI-ready pada produk ini sebaiknya dipahami sebagai positioning platform, bukan sebagai klaim performa AI yang sudah terukur.
Alternatif Windows untuk Laptop Tipis di Bawah 1 Kg
Kehadiran MacBook Neo menjadi salah satu latar yang digunakan ADVAN untuk menjelaskan posisi AIR NEO. Keduanya sama-sama bermain pada gagasan laptop yang ringan, tipis, dan ditujukan untuk kebutuhan produktivitas.
Namun, AIR NEO memiliki pendekatan berbeda dengan menggunakan Windows dan prosesor Intel. Hal ini membuatnya menyasar pengguna yang membutuhkan fleksibilitas ekosistem Windows untuk pekerjaan, pendidikan, bisnis, maupun kebutuhan personal.
Bagi ADVAN, laptop tipis bukan sekadar soal mengecilkan ukuran perangkat. CEO ADVAN Chandra Tansri mengatakan konsumen kini juga mempertimbangkan bobot, desain, serta kesiapan perangkat terhadap perkembangan teknologi.
“Kami ingin membuktikan bahwa brand Indonesia juga mampu menghadirkan laptop yang memiliki desain dan teknologi yang kompetitif di pasar global. AIR NEO adalah representasi dari semangat tersebut,” kata Chandra.
Dengan bobot 0,99 kg, AIR NEO memang memiliki salah satu karakteristik yang cukup jelas untuk bersaing di kategori laptop ultraportable: mudah dibawa tanpa harus beralih ke perangkat dengan layar berukuran sangat kecil. ADVAN tidak hanya menyertakan perangkat, tetapi juga ADP Protection selama satu tahun. Layanan perlindungan tambahan ini didukung oleh PT bolttech Insurance Broker.
ADVAN menempatkannya sebagai bagian dari upaya memberikan perlindungan tambahan bagi pengguna yang membawa laptop dalam aktivitas sehari-hari dengan mobilitas tinggi.
Meski demikian, materi peluncuran belum merinci cakupan perlindungan, jenis kerusakan yang ditanggung, maupun mekanisme klaim. Detail tersebut perlu dilihat pada ketentuan ADP Protection yang berlaku saat pembelian.
Harga ADVAN AIR NEO Mulai Rp9,99 Juta
ADVAN AIR NEO diluncurkan secara eksklusif melalui Shopee mulai 9 September 2026. Pada periode launching, harga yang ditawarkan adalah varian dengan Intel Core 3 Processor 304 harga Rp9.999.000 dan Intel Core 5 Processor 320 harga Rp11.999.000 Terdapat promo voucher diskon hingga 45% selama periode launching
Dengan harga mulai Rp9,99 juta, AIR NEO mencoba menawarkan kombinasi yang cukup spesifik: bobot di bawah 1 kg, ketebalan 12,9 mm, bodi metal, layar 14 inci, serta prosesor Intel Core Series 3.
Namun, masih ada sejumlah spesifikasi penting yang belum tercantum dalam materi peluncuran, termasuk kapasitas RAM, penyimpanan, baterai, konfigurasi port, webcam, dan sistem pendingin. Detail tersebut nantinya akan menjadi bagian penting untuk melihat posisi AIR NEO ketika dibandingkan dengan laptop tipis lain di kelas harga yang sama.

items.author: Chris Donkin
items.content:
Indian smartphone manufacturer Lava International made its debut in the UK at the end of August with a mid-tier offering. To coincide with the launch MD Sunil Raina caught up with Mobile World Live to discuss how he hopes it can stand out in its first market in the West.
Lava is positioning the AGNI 4N smartphone as having the highest build and component quality available in the mid-range, with the added benefit of no so-called “bloatware”. It is priced around the £500 mark.
The company’s foray into the UK comes after 17 years of supplying feature phones and then smartphones in its home market, where it also manufacturers the handsets.
It has a presence in over 20 countries, but Raina noted the UK would be its first “Western” venture.
The executive highlighted the business has “continuously grown in smartphones over the last 5 years,” though from a relatively small base, in an era of flat conditions for the overall market.
This factor “typically means that you are able to take share” from larger rivals; something the company aims to do in its new mature market.
Raina believes there is an opportunity in the UK’s Android segment given the high market penetration of Samsung and few alternatives in the mid-tier gaining significant traction.
He noted there was a relatively low penetration rate of Chinese brands in some Western markets, including the UK, companies which are stronger in this mid-range elsewhere in the world.
Lava’s origins, he hopes, will provide an advantage given India’s trustworthy status in the UK and the fact “there’s also a huge diaspora” who “I think would perhaps like to carry one of our products”.
Its debut device in the country is being sold initially through online channels. Subsequent releases are likely to be at the same or lower tier than the AGNI 4N.
“Because this is our first foray into a Western market we would like to gauge how it goes, take the first few steps wisely and cautiously,” Raina said, noting over the years it has learnt how to survive in a challenging and always shifting industry, building a brand for the long term.
“Very few companies who started around the same time we started could manage to survive in this industry,” he added, pointing to former big names who have come and gone include BlackBerry and HTC.
Youthful outlook
Lava intends to position its debut UK release at the “mid belly” of the market primarily to an audience of young people.
Promoted points include a lack of already installed apps and other “bloatware” on the device when people buy it and use of high-quality components for its price.
Raina noted there was a trend for some makers of Android-based phones to install “dozens of applications” before sale, which consume valuable memory and potentially raise security issues, as well as being a general inconvenience for the consumer.
Lava promotes supplying a “very clean” version of the operating system.
The executive noted it delivers a high build quality and performance levels at the upper end of the mid-range.
Its AGNI 4N has an aluminium alloy metal frame, glass back and uses a MediaTek Dimensity 8350 chipset, alongside AI and camera features similar to those frequently promoted in the mid-tier.
“Below a certain price point there are a lot of compromises that brands make in terms of the build quality of the phone,” he asserted, stating many around the mid-price were “more plasticy” than its offering.
Below a certain price point there are a lot of compromises that brands make in terms of the build quality of the phone
Sunil Raina, MD
Lava International
Raina argues some brands which also sell at higher tiers have a vested interest in making their top products “more aspirational and therefore compromise at the lower level”.
In terms of its audience, the device is aimed primarily at a younger demographic who want high performance to suit popular applications such as gaming, but may not have a premium budget.
“It’s in a sweet spot where young people will be able to do high performance tasks, but at a price point which is good for their pockets as well”.
“We believe this device will be able to do a lot more things that other devices cannot at this price segment,” he concluded.

items.author: Palak Sharma
items.content:
Bengaluru-based restaurant company Popo Global, which operates gourmet food brands including The Pizza Bakery, Paris Panini and Smash Guys, has raised ₹532 Cr (around $56 Mn) from Artal Asia.
Popo Global did not disclose its valuation and the size of Artal Asia’s stake.
Founded in 2017 by brothers Nikhil Gupta and Abhijit “AB” Gupta, Popo Global began with gourmet sourdough pizza brand The Pizza Bakery. It later expanded its portfolio with Paris Panini, which offers French-inspired paninis, sandwiches, wraps, and crepes, and smash burger brand Smash Guys.
The company claims to operate 41 outlets across Bengaluru.
With the latest investment, Popo Global plans to expand beyond Bengaluru and scale its portfolio of food brands across India.
Popo Global said its operating model combines the convenience of quick-service restaurants, the customer experience associated with fine dining, and the scalability of delivery kitchens.
The company said its model focuses on core products, dine-in and delivery channels, standardised processes, and restaurant real estate selection.
It also claimed to have recorded strong same-store sales growth, repeat rates, and unit economics, but did not disclose the underlying figures. Popo Global added that it had largely bootstrapped its expansion in Bengaluru before the latest transaction.
“Bringing Artal Asia into Popo lets us think considerably bigger while keeping the spirit that got us here – never cutting any corners on quality. They have partnered with some of the world’s most successful food businesses, and they understand that the product has to stay at the centre of it,” said the cofounders.
Artal Asia is an affiliate of global investment firm Artal Group. Its India portfolio includes Capital Foods (later acquired by Tata Consumer Products), Burger Singh, and Jumbotail.
The investment comes amid continued investor interest in Indian restaurant and food brands looking to expand their offline presence and enter new markets.
Foodtech startup Dil Foods recently raised ₹72 Cr to expand its footprint and launch more cuisine offerings.
Similarly, Gen Z-focussed cafe chain Alienkind raised $3.2 Mn in June to enter new markets and support its next phase of growth. Meanwhile, Bengaluru-based bubble tea and QSR brand Boba Bhai raised ₹40 Cr to expand its offline presence earlier this year.

items.content:
Dibandingkan kacamata konvensional, solusi kacamata pintar alias smart glasses menawarkan fungsi-fungsi ekstra dari sebuah alat bantu yang kita gunakan sehari-hari. Mulai dari menangkap momen dengan kamera hingga memutar musik, tampilannya pun beragam. Dan GetD GSPro mencoba menawarkan sebuah kacamata pintar dengan fungsi yang tidak kalah komplit, meski tanpa kamera khusus.
Merek GetD sendiri tim Gizmologi baru temukan saat berkesempatan untuk mengunjungi Global Connect Show 2026 yang digelar di Shenzhen, Juni kemarin. Dalam pameran tersebut, mereka menunjukkan sejumlah produk wearables yang didominasi oleh kacamata pintar berbasis AI. Hadir dalam berbagai desain bingkai alias frame berbeda, dan sejumlah varian di antaranya telah meraih pencapaian khusus.
Termasuk GetD GSPro yang berhasil memenangkan Good Design Award 2025 hingga iF DESIGN AWARD 2026. Tidak hanya itu, kacamata pintar satu ini diklaim hadir sebagai yang pertama di dunia untuk integrasikan fungsi pemantauan kesehatan serta dukungan Apple Find My. Lantas apa saja keunggulan GetD GSPro terutama bila dibandingkan dengan yang sudah lebih populer seperti kacamata RayBan Meta?
Baca juga: Hadir di Indonesia, Rokid Tunjukkan Pemanfaatan AI Smart Glasses untuk Sehari-hari hingga Industri
Dapat Terintegrasi ke Jaringan Apple Find My
View this post on Instagram
Secara desain frame GetD GSPro sendiri terlihat cukup mirip seperti kacamata konvensional saja, tersedia dalam beberapa opsi desain berbeda, namun dengan tangkai yang relatif lebih ramping dibandingkan RayBane Meta. Begitu pula bagian bingkai depannya—wajar saja, mengingat GetD GSPro smart glasses tidak dilengkapi oleh sensor kamera khusus. Lantas apakah fungsi pintarnya jadi terbatas? Tidak juga.
Kacamata pintar GetD GSPro dilengkapi dengan sejumlah speaker hingga mikrofon, yang tidak hanya dapat difungsikan untuk mendengarkan musik maupun panggilan suara, namun juga akses AI melalui perintah suara. Di mana fitur ini integrasikan akses dengan ChatGPT maupun Google Gemini, untuk interaksi sampai kemampuan terjemah secara real-time.
Dan seperti yang sudah disinggung sebelumnya, produk kacamata pintar GetD GSPro sudah mendukung fitur Apple Find My, dengan kata lain mampu mereduksi risiko kehilangan. Sehingga ketika diletakkan atau tertinggal di suatu tempat yang jauh sekalipun, pemilik tetap mampu melacak lokasinya lewat aplikasi Find My dari produk Apple.
GetD juga memasarkan kacamata pintarnya agar nyaman untuk digunakan komunikasi sepanjang hari. Teknologi VAGC memastikan volume selalu tepat mengikuti jumlah noise di sekitar, sementara tiga mikrofon dengan dukungan ENC memastikan suara pengguna dapat tertangkap lebih jelas. Memberikan pengalaman saat berkomunikasi yang lebih seamless.
Harga Kacamata Pintar GetD GSPro Lebih Terjangkau dari RayBan Meta
Kacamata GetD GSPro hadir dengan sertifikasi IPX4, sehingga aman meski terkena cipratan air sekalipun. Sementara daya tahan baterai GetD GSPro diklaim bisa bertahan hingga 11 jam, meski tidak disebutkan secara gamblang apakah durasi tersebut hanya untuk memutar musik atau skenario lainnya.
Fitur GetD GSPro lainnya yang terbilang menarik, adalah pemantauan kesehatan khusus. Ya, bukan kemampuan untuk melacak denyut jantung, melainkan fitur pengingat seperti ketika pengguna sudah duduk terlalu lama, postur pundak yang kurang tepat, maupun peringatan risiko terjatuh. Setidaknya kemampuan pelacakan tiga poin tersebut mampu berikan poin plus, demi pengguna yang lebih mindful atas aktivitas mereka sehari-hari.
Perangkat ini dapat diisi daya melalui pengisi daya magnetik, sementara bagian lensanya tentu dapat dikustomisasi sesuai kondisi penglihatan masing-masing pengguna. Bagian lainnya terbilang mirip seperti RayBan Meta, di mana bagian tangkai dilengkapi tombol maupun permukaan yang sensitif dengan sentuhan, untuk input gestur khusus.
Dan untuk memberikan poin kenyamanan ekstra, frame kacamata GetD GSPro tersedia dalam opsi titanium, yang selain ringan juga memberikan durabilitas tinggi. Bila ditilik langsung dari situs resmi GetD, harga GetD GSPro sendiri dibanderol mulai USD 219,99 atau sekitar Rp3,8 jutaan. Menurut Gizmo friends apakah harga tersebut sepadan dengan apa yang dapat ditawarkan?

items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) could start trial production of its next-generation 1.4nm chip as early as April 2027, according to a new report from Taiwanese media.
TSMC’s 1.4nm technology, also known as the 14A process, will succeed its 2nm process. The reported timeline would allow the company to start production much earlier than previously expected and could strengthen its position in the advanced semiconductor market.
TSMC Could Start 1.4nm Chip Production in April 2027
TSMC is building its 1.4nm manufacturing facilities in Taichung. Construction of the technology park reportedly began in October 2025.
The site will eventually include four factories. Work on the first factory has progressed to the construction of its floors and walls after workers completed the initial steel structure. Authorities expect construction of the first facility to finish by early 2027.
Based on the latest timeline, the first factory could begin trial production in April 2027. TSMC could then move to mass production during the second half of the year.
Mass Production May Begin in October 2027
The second facility, known as P2, is also under construction. Workers have completed its concrete foundation and are now working on the steel structure.
If construction stays on schedule, P2 could be completed by October 2027. The latest plans suggest that the first two factories could reach mass production around October 2027.
This would represent a significant acceleration compared with earlier expectations. Previous plans had indicated that TSMC’s 1.4nm mass production would begin in 2028.
Two More Facilities Planned
TSMC also has plans for two additional factories at the Taichung site. The third facility remains in its early construction phase, while the company has obtained the necessary construction license for it.
The fourth facility is also part of the long-term expansion plan. Authorities expect the two later factories to be completed in 2028, with their construction schedules separated by around six months.
TSMC is reportedly investing about $49 billion in the overall project. The investment is expected to increase the company’s capacity for producing advanced chips.
See Also: Kuo Calls Apple Chip Stockpile Rumor Unlikely Given Tight TSMC Planning Cycle
TSMC Could Strengthen Its Chipmaking Lead
The reported acceleration comes after an earlier report in July suggested that TSMC could begin pilot production of its 1.4nm process in the third quarter of 2027.
If the latest timeline proves accurate, TSMC could move into trial production several months earlier than that estimate. The company is developing the 14A process as its next major step after 2nm technology.
Earlier production of 1.4nm chips could help TSMC maintain its position among the world’s leading contract chip manufacturers as demand for increasingly powerful processors continues to grow.

items.content:

The Punjab government has announced plans to introduce 1,500 electric buses across 91 tehsils of the province from January 2027. The move aims to improve public transport and provide cleaner and more affordable travel options for residents.
Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz has approved dedicated electric bus depots for each tehsil. The first batch of new electric buses is expected to reach Lahore in January.
The provincial government has also set a larger target of putting 3,000 electric buses into operation across Punjab by June 2027.
Punjab to Launch 1,500 Electric Buses in 91 Tehsils From January 2027
According to the plan, different districts will receive buses based on their transport requirements. Multan’s nine tehsils will receive 169 buses, while four tehsils of Sahiwal will get 87 buses.
Bahawalpur will receive 215 buses for its 11 tehsils. Dera Ghazi Khan’s 10 tehsils will get 63 buses, while Faisalabad’s 12 tehsils will receive 202 buses.
Sargodha’s 14 tehsils will receive 98 buses. Gujranwala’s seven tehsils will get 125 buses, while eight tehsils of Gujrat will receive 122 buses.
Rawalpindi will receive 219 buses for its 16 tehsils.
612 Electric Buses Already Operational
The Punjab government said 612 electric buses are already fully operational in different districts. These buses are currently serving millions of commuters every day.
Another 192 buses are expected to become operational in Multan and other districts within the coming days.
The government also plans to expand electric bus services to several other areas, including Lahore, Faisalabad, Sargodha, Sahiwal, Muzaffargarh, Rawalpindi, Jhang, Bahawalpur, Rahim Yar Khan and Attock.
Additional services are also planned for Bhakkar, Hafizabad, Khanewal, Chiniot, Layyah, Okara, Sialkot, Murree, Gujrat and Sheikhupura.
Mandi Bahauddin, Vehari, Kasur, Lodhran, Nankana Sahib, Narowal, Gujranwala and Multan are also included in the expansion plan.
Punjab Sets September Target
Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz has directed officials to complete the first phase of the electric bus programme by the end of September 2026.
The expansion is part of the provincial government’s wider efforts to improve public transport infrastructure and provide better commuting facilities across Punjab.
See Also: Islamabad Police Gets 50 BYD Electric Vehicles for New Capital Patrol Force
Mass Transit Projects Also Underway
The meeting also reviewed progress on mass transit systems planned for Faisalabad and Gujranwala. Officials said work on both projects was moving forward rapidly.
At the same time, the government is working on the rehabilitation and reconstruction of 25 stations of the Lahore Metrobus service.
The expansion of electric buses, along with new and upgraded mass transit systems, is expected to strengthen Punjab’s public transport network and make daily travel easier for commuters across the province.

items.author: Usama Anjum
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
Karachi has recorded a sharp expansion in its 5G infrastructure, with the number of operational 5G sites rising from 90 to 279 in July 2026, according to documents from the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA).
The increase of 189 new sites reflects the rapid expansion of next-generation mobile services in the country’s largest city, as operators continue the first phase of Pakistan’s 5G rollout.
Among the operators, Jazz has deployed the highest number of 5G sites in Karachi at 130, followed by Zong with 122 and Ufone with 27.
PTA said the growth in 5G sites shows that operators are accelerating network upgrades in major urban centers. Mobile companies have so far launched 5G services in 23 cities across Pakistan, with Karachi receiving the largest number of sites.
Karachi Targeted for At Least 1,000 5G Sites
Karachi currently has around 5,000 LTE and 4G sites, according to the documents. By the end of the first phase of the rollout, operators will be required to deploy at least 1,000 5G sites in Karachi.
The 1,000-site target is a minimum licensing obligation, meaning the final number of sites could go higher depending on network demand and operator investment.
Under the broader rollout framework, each mobile operator is required to deploy 2,000 5G sites during the first phase.
Operators must also upgrade at least 20% of their existing 4G sites to 5G in federal and provincial capitals.
The rollout requirements also include stronger fiber connectivity. Mobile operators will be required to increase the fiber-to-the-tower ratio to at least 20% during the first phase.
PTA has set a median 5G speed benchmark of 50 Mbps initially, with a phased target to raise the median speed to 100 Mbps.
The regulator said it is continuing to monitor operators’ 5G deployment plans to ensure licensing obligations, speed targets, and infrastructure requirements are being met.
The latest expansion in Karachi suggests the city will remain a major focus of Pakistan’s 5G rollout as operators scale up coverage, capacity, and network performance.

Pakistan’s 5G Rollout Faces Fresh Uncertainty After Right of Way Bill Withdrawal

items.title: Cape Town startups invited to apply for climate-focused Shine programme
items.summary:
Cape Town-based early-stage ventures building climate and urban sustainability solutions are invited to apply for Shine 2027, which offers participants EUR50,000 (US$58,000) in grant funding, hands-on expertise, and a place in a global climate innovation network.
Delivered by the Swiss Re Foundation in partnership with Climate KIC, Shine 2027 backs founders working on solutions in energy, buildings, transport, waste, urban nature, and climate data and governance.
The programme is open to early-stage ventures operating in or serving Cape Town, Bangalore, Bratislava, London, Manila, Mexico City, New York and Zurich. Selected ventures receive seed grant funding, peer-like mentoring by Swiss Re talents of the region, alongside a place in a global network of climate innovators spanning all eight cities. The backing continues past the initial grant, with ventures that go on to demonstrate scale being potentially eligible for further support.
Applications are open until September 15.

items.content: Shares of One 97 Communications, the parent company of fintech major Paytm, rallied as much as 4% to Rs 1,804 after international brokerage Bernstein named the stock its top pick, citing robust merchant lending growth, operating leverage and the potential introduction of MDR on UPI as key drivers of earnings growth.With a target price of Rs 2,200, the brokerage forecasts an upside potential of up to 26% from current market levels. Bernstein expects Paytm’s EPS to reach Rs 78 by FY29. Even after excluding any potential impact from MDR on UPI, its FY29E EPS estimate stands at Rs 54, still above the Rs 46 consensus estimate.Why are Bernstein analysts bullish on Paytm shares?1.) Merchant loans are a key driver: Bernstein expects Paytm’s financial services revenue to grow at around 27% CAGR between FY26E and FY30E, driven primarily by its merchant loan distribution business. The brokerage expects merchant loans to remain the key contributor, accounting for around 75% of financial services revenue.Bernstein sees Paytm having a clear competitive advantage and a long runway for growth, even if the company only achieves modest increases in loan penetration among its merchant base.2.) Strong operating leverage: Analysts expect meaningful operating leverage from Paytm’s existing businesses, with indirect expenses projected to grow only around 8% as key cost drivers peak. Technology costs are expected to remain stable, while slower device additions should keep sales and merchant acquisition costs under control.Any incremental spending is likely to be directed towards new initiatives that can generate additional revenue.3.) MDR to boost profitability - Bernstein expects MDR on UPI to provide a meaningful boost to Paytm’s profitability. The brokerage points out that payment activity is highly concentrated, with around 4% of transactions accounting for 70% of transaction value, while the top 5% of merchants contribute the bulk of payment value.Given this concentration, Bernstein remains positive on the potential earnings upside for Paytm, regardless of how the eventual MDR framework is structured.Bernstein lists downside risks for Paytm stockMDR on UPI is not introduced: The estimates assume the introduction of MDR on UPI transactions, which accounts for 30% of our EBITDA forecasts. Consequently, any decision by the government or regulator to retain the zero-MDR framework, whether due to merchant resistance, policy considerations, or concerns around digital payment adoption, would represent a material downside risk to earnings estimates.While Paytm's core payments, merchant subscriptions and lending businesses would remain intact, the absence of MDR would eliminate a significant earnings driver that’s baked into the base case, it said.Slowdown in device additions: The forecasts assume device additions will gradually moderate from the current >20% growth rate. A sharper-than-expected slowdown in merchant acquisition could weigh on subscription revenue, merchant loans and payment monetisation, given the central role of Paytm’s device network in driving growth across its ecosystem.Paytm shares have had a stellar 2026 despite overall weakness, as the stock has rallied over 70% in the last six months.Disclaimer: The views/recommendations mentioned in this article, wherever applicable, are those of the respective SEBI-registered Research Analyst/brokerage and have been reproduced/reported with due attribution. They should not be construed as the views or recommendations of The Economic Times Digital or the journalist. Menjelang peluncuran tersebut, vivo mulai mengungkap sejumlah detail mengenai desain perangkat, termasuk vivo X500 sebagai model standar. Smartphone ini hadir dengan tampilan belakang yang cukup berbeda dibandingkan generasi sebelumnya, vivo X300.
Perubahan paling mudah terlihat ada pada bagian kamera. vivo X500 menggunakan modul kamera berbentuk lingkaran besar yang ditempatkan di sisi kiri panel belakang. Modul tersebut kemudian berada di dalam area kamera berbentuk persegi panjang yang membentang hampir sepanjang lebar bodi. Sementara itu, LED flash ditempatkan di luar lingkaran kamera.
Dari sisi pilihan warna, vivo X500 akan tersedia dalam empat opsi, yakni hitam, abu-abu muda, merah muda muda, dan satu varian dengan finishing gradasi. Desain tersebut membuat X500 terlihat cukup berbeda dari X500 Pro dan X500 Pro Max yang sebelumnya sudah diperlihatkan vivo. Dengan begitu, perusahaan tampaknya memang ingin memberikan identitas visual tersendiri untuk masing-masing model.
Baca Juga: vivo V80 Lite Debut di Malaysia dengan Baterai 10.000 mAh, Pecahkan Rekor Guinness
Desain Kamera Berubah, Sensor Utama Ikut Naik Kelas
Selain desain, vivo sebelumnya mengonfirmasi bahwa X500 akan menggunakan sensor kamera utama dan telefoto yang sama seperti vivo X300 Pro. Informasi ini cukup menarik karena model standar mendapatkan perangkat keras kamera yang sebelumnya digunakan pada varian Pro.
Meski demikian, kesamaan sensor tidak otomatis berarti kemampuan fotografi keduanya akan identik. Hasil akhir kamera tetap dapat dipengaruhi oleh pemrosesan gambar, konfigurasi lensa, serta perangkat lunak yang digunakan. Detail lengkap mengenai kemampuan kameranya baru bisa dinilai setelah perangkat resmi tersedia dan diuji secara langsung.
Punya Identitas Berbeda dari Model Pro
Menariknya, vivo X500 justru memiliki desain yang berbeda dari X500 Pro dan X500 Pro Max. Perbedaan ini kemungkinan menjadi bagian dari strategi vivo untuk membedakan setiap kelas perangkat, meski ketiganya berada dalam keluarga yang sama.
Untuk saat ini, informasi mengenai spesifikasi lengkap X500 masih terbatas. Peluncuran pada 21 September nanti diharapkan akan mengungkap lebih banyak detail mengenai chipset, layar, baterai, serta harga perangkat. Yang juga masih belum diketahui adalah apakah X500 akan dipasarkan di luar China dan bagaimana posisinya jika masuk ke pasar global.

items.author: Onsa Mustafa
items.content:
Copyright protected content copied from PhoneWorld website.
WhatsApp is rolling out a new Events hub that makes it easier for users to create, manage, and review events from one place. The new feature is currently available to some Android beta testers.
The update adds a dedicated Events section to WhatsApp settings. According to WABetaInfo, users can use this section to access their existing events and create new ones without opening individual chats.
WhatsApp Introduces New Hub to Create and Manage Events
WhatsApp has been expanding its event features over the past few updates. The platform previously allowed users to create events in group chats, communities, and individual conversations.
However, finding an event could be difficult when users had to search through their chats. The new Events hub addresses this issue by bringing all events together on a single page.
WhatsApp marks the new section with a badge in the settings menu so users can easily find it. The hub displays events created by the user as well as events they have been invited to attend.
How to Create an Event
Users can open the Events hub and select Create event to set up a new event. WhatsApp provides several options during the process.
Users can add an event name, description, start date and time, end time, and location. They can also choose whether to add a WhatsApp call link.
The app sets a reminder for one hour before the event by default, although users can change the reminder time. WhatsApp also automatically adds the host’s name.
Users can decide whether guests can bring additional people to the event. They can also add a cover photo to make the event easier to recognize.
Users will still be able to create events directly from their chats and groups.
People Without WhatsApp Can Join
One of the useful parts of the new event system is that users can invite people who do not have a WhatsApp account.
When an event is created, WhatsApp generates an invitation link. Anyone with the link can open it and view basic information such as the event name, date, and time.
The guest can then respond to the invitation without having a WhatsApp account. They need to provide their name and verify their phone number.
After confirming attendance, guests can access additional information, including the full location and WhatsApp call link.
What Information Can Guests See?
Event information is visible to guests on WhatsApp. This includes the event name, date, time, location, cover photo, and guest list.
The host can see each guest’s name, response, and phone number to manage the event. Guests who confirm their attendance can also see the names and responses of other attendees.
Phone numbers remain limited based on contact settings. Guests can only see another attendee’s phone number if they already have that person’s number saved as a contact.
WhatsApp says personal messages and calls remain end-to-end encrypted.
See Also: WhatsApp Rolls Out Full Liquid Glass Design to More iPhone Users
Availability
The new Events hub is rolling out with WhatsApp beta for Android version 2.26.36.5. The feature is currently available to some beta testers through the Google Play Store.
Since WhatsApp is releasing the feature gradually, not every beta user will see the new Events section immediately. The company has not yet announced when the Events hub will become available to all users.
The dedicated hub should make WhatsApp’s event tools more convenient, especially for users who regularly organize meetings, appointments, meetups, and other group activities.
